---
title: "Search"
---

```{=html}
<div class="single-post-area">
<div class="post-body">
<section class="article-card">
<p class="card-kicker">REPOSITORY SEARCH</p>
<h1>Search</h1>
<form class="site-search-page" action="search.html" method="get" id="search-form">
<label for="search-query">Search research and articles</label>
<div class="search-page-controls">
<input id="search-query" name="q" type="search" placeholder="Search research, analytics, or topics...">
<button class="btn-primary" type="submit">Search</button>
</div>
</form>
<div id="search-results" aria-live="polite">
<p class="search-status" id="search-status-text">Enter keywords above or search across research domains.</p>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  var corpus = [
    {
      title: "Strategic Research Synthesis: Cognitive Neuroscience & E-Commerce Scalability",
      url: "research.html",
      category: "Research / Publication",
      snippet: "An empirical synthesis investigating how neuroscientific models and systems dynamics inform modern digital commerce and customer decision velocity."
    },
    {
      title: "Operational Status: Primary Observation Field",
      url: "index.html",
      category: "Repository / Status",
      snippet: "Primary observation field tracking repository initialization and foundational ResearchGate publication in progress."
    },
    {
      title: "Customer-Centric Decision Frameworks & Scalability Analytics",
      url: "analytics.html",
      category: "Analytics / Methodology",
      snippet: "Data-driven analyses, decision frameworks, visual explanations, and analytical experiments in digital commerce and human cognition."
    },
    {
      title: "About MS Emon & Interdisciplinary Research Direction",
      url: "about.html",
      category: "Profile / Overview",
      snippet: "MS Emon's research direction at the intersection of systems thinking, cognitive neuroscience, e-commerce, and customer-centric decision frameworks."
    },
    {
      title: "ResearchGate Author Profile: Md. Salauddin Emon",
      url: "https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Md-Salauddin-Emon",
      category: "External / Publications",
      snippet: "Formal academic publications, author profile, and research network for Md. Salauddin Emon."
    }
  ];

  function runSearch() {
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var q = (params.get('q') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    var inputEl = document.getElementById('search-query');
    var resultsEl = document.getElementById('search-results');
    var statusText = document.getElementById('search-status-text');

    if (inputEl && q) inputEl.value = params.get('q');

    if (!q) {
      if (statusText) statusText.textContent = "Enter keywords above or search across research domains.";
      return;
    }

    var matches = corpus.filter(function(item) {
      return item.title.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 ||
             item.snippet.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 ||
             item.category.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
    });

    if (matches.length === 0) {
      resultsEl.innerHTML = '<p class="search-status">No matching research records found for "<strong>' + escapeHtml(q) + '</strong>". Try searching for <em>neuroscience</em>, <em>systems</em>, <em>commerce</em>, or <em>analytics</em>.</p>';
    } else {
      var html = '<p class="search-status">Found <strong>' + matches.length + '</strong> result' + (matches.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' for "<strong>' + escapeHtml(q) + '</strong>":</p>';
      html += '<div class="search-results-list">';
      matches.forEach(function(m) {
        var isExt = m.url.startsWith('http');
        html += '<div class="search-result-item">' +
          '<div class="search-result-meta">' + escapeHtml(m.category) + '</div>' +
          '<h3><a href="' + m.url + '"' + (isExt ? ' target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"' : '') + '>' + escapeHtml(m.title) + '</a></h3>' +
          '<p>' + escapeHtml(m.snippet) + '</p>' +
          '<a href="' + m.url + '" class="read-more"' + (isExt ? ' target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"' : '') + '>Open Record</a>' +
          '</div>';
      });
      html += '</div>';
      resultsEl.innerHTML = html;
    }
  }

  function escapeHtml(s) {
    return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', runSearch);
  } else {
    runSearch();
  }
})();
</script>
```
